methods: Direct javap inspection of the pinned original Java 1.21 classes, identified with the official mappings; no REA.

Outside-repository reflection helper executed unchanged ServerPacksSource.createVanillaPackSource, MultiPackResourceManager(SERVER_DATA, singleton vanilla pack), TagLoader.loadAndBuild and item Registry.bindTags, followed by the actual built-in registry lookup provider.

The helper invoked unchanged SimpleJsonResourceReloadListener.prepare and RecipeManager.apply, then observed RecipeManager.getAllRecipesFor encounter order, Recipe.getResultItem, ItemStack.getDescriptionId, actual item registry numeric IDs/keys, Item.requiredFeatures and FeatureFlagRegistry.toNames.
Original prepare returned java.util.HashMap with 1290 recipes; original item tag loading bound 147 item tags. Two independent helper JVM runs produced byte-identical observations.

For each of 57 actual default stonecutting ingredient items, original recipe.matches(SingleRecipeInput, null) was called and actual output description IDs checked. No same-input description ties occurred; maximum matching recipes was 16.

For each of 27 smithing recipes, an input from its actual Ingredient.getItems was passed to unchanged RecipeManager.getRecipesFor(type, input, null); each returned exactly the expected singleton. These matches and singleton comparator paths do not access the null Level argument.

Every recorded numeric item ID/name and stonecutting result was checked against the existing item and recipe catalogs; all smithing ingredient sets and transform outputs were checked against the recipe catalog. The catalogs do not supply the captured Java recipe order.
provenance.result_order_method: smithing_input_order is the actual unchanged RecipeManager.getAllRecipesFor encounter order. smithing_result_order is a stable Java Stream.sorted(Comparator.comparing(actual Recipe.getResultItem(actual lookup).getDescriptionId)) of that captured list, the comparator used by getRecipesFor. Filtering commutes with this stable key sort. All 18 trim previews tie at item.minecraft.iron_chestplate and retain captured encounter order. This is not a direct getRecipesFor query matching all 27 recipes.
provenance.scope: Pinned unchanged default vanilla pack, item tags and recipe/catalog snapshot only. This metadata does not certify custom packs, resource reloads, alternate enabled-feature owners, or a production Level. Production must bind the actual recipe snapshot and Level enabled-feature state.
